method: corpus-blind controlled generator; 38 practical/natural/physical cross-domain cases

cases.knowledge_need: How a cold, damp letter and an overheated wax taper can produce a brittle seal that fails during travel.
cases.circumstances: rain has soaked the courier's cloak and the only hearth burns hot
cases.situation: Before noon she must close a folded account note so its fastening survives the road.

cases.knowledge_need: How overnight soaking, cool water, and a sudden sour smell distinguish usable softened grain from a batch beginning to spoil.
cases.circumstances: a warm spell follows a cold evening
cases.situation: At dawn he finds yesterday's barley pail changed and must decide what can safely become breakfast.

cases.knowledge_need: How a blocked yard channel can redirect meltwater under a woodpile and soften the ground beneath a loaded cart.
cases.circumstances: two days of thaw follow deep packed snow
cases.situation: She sees water pooling by the gate shortly before a cart is due to leave.

cases.knowledge_need: How straw packing, vibration, and a partly frozen road affect stacked unfired clay vessels on a handcart.
cases.circumstances: a night frost has left hard ridges in yesterday's mud
cases.situation: He must bring green ware to a kiln without cracking rims against one another.

cases.knowledge_need: How humid air and a wooden scoop carrying food residue make a sack of salt clump and become less useful for preserving food.
cases.circumstances: fog has remained indoors after a wet morning unloading boats
cases.situation: Before fish are brought in, she notices the salt no longer pours freely.

cases.knowledge_need: How cutting reeds too close to waterlogged ground changes their dryness and suitability for patching a leaking roof.
cases.circumstances: a dry week follows spring flooding
cases.situation: He has gathered a bundle and must judge whether it can be used before the next rain.

cases.knowledge_need: How bruised fruit, delayed crushing, and a dirty press cloth can turn a sweet pressing into an off-smelling one.
cases.circumstances: a cart ride from the trees jostled the harvest in warm weather
cases.situation: At afternoon she must prepare sound fruit before the press is needed by another family.

cases.knowledge_need: How a hidden frozen knot and a glancing wedge strike can send a split piece sideways toward nearby feet.
cases.circumstances: hard overnight frost has stiffened a damp log
cases.situation: Before supper he needs kindling but the first blow opens the wood unevenly.

cases.knowledge_need: How wet flax cord shrinks as it dries and can distort a repaired fishing net if new knots are pulled too tight.
cases.circumstances: rain stopped only an hour ago
cases.situation: She must patch a torn mesh before the crew launches at dawn.

cases.knowledge_need: How drying soaked leather too close to a hearth can harden it and pull a stitched seam out of shape.
cases.circumstances: a stream crossing filled one boot during a cold journey
cases.situation: At night he needs it usable again by morning without ruining its fit.

cases.knowledge_need: How placing a charcoal brazier near bedding in a closed room can combine heat, smoke, and stale air into a sleeping hazard.
cases.circumstances: wind drives snow against the shutter gaps
cases.situation: After dark he wants warmth for an ill guest while others are already lying down.

cases.knowledge_need: How a candle's tilted wick, pooled wax, and a moving draft can cause flame to reach a rush holder.
cases.circumstances: a door is repeatedly opened during an evening storm
cases.situation: She must keep enough light to finish a page without igniting nearby scraps.

cases.knowledge_need: How exertion in wet wool, a sudden stop, and wind exposure can cool a person faster than the air temperature suggests.
cases.circumstances: a cold shower catches him while moving sheep uphill
cases.situation: At sunset he reaches a fence repair and must choose whether to keep working.

cases.knowledge_need: How a long pole load shifts from one carrier to another and can twist a shoulder when one end catches brush.
cases.circumstances: two workers carry a timber through narrow young trees
cases.situation: One end snags and she feels a sudden pull while still far from the clearing.

cases.knowledge_need: How repeated feet, rain, and drainage from an uphill roof can turn a narrow path into slippery exposed clay.
cases.circumstances: several wet days follow a busy market
cases.situation: He must carry a covered pot downhill without taking the worn central track blindly.

cases.knowledge_need: How finger placement, uneven stone shape, and a muddy landing spot affect the risk of crushed hands while building a low wall.
cases.circumstances: recent rain softened the soil beside the foundation
cases.situation: She and a partner must lower a heavy facing stone into place.

cases.knowledge_need: How a loose whetstone, a wet sleeve, and sharpening toward the hand can turn routine edge care into a cut risk.
cases.circumstances: morning dew still wets clothing and tools
cases.situation: Before resuming cutting he needs to restore a blade dulled by a hidden stone.

cases.knowledge_need: How food scraps near a weak gate can concentrate pigs' pushing and make a damaged latch fail at once.
cases.circumstances: rain has swollen the wooden gate frame
cases.situation: She brings a pail of peelings and sees the animals crowding the entrance.

cases.knowledge_need: How a tether line can wrap around a sapling and shorten unnoticed, leaving a goat unable to reach water or shade.
cases.circumstances: a hot afternoon follows quiet grazing
cases.situation: On returning with a bucket he finds the animal has circled a young tree.

cases.knowledge_need: How warm damp grass buried in a tight stack can heat internally and spoil even when its outer layer feels dry.
cases.circumstances: a brief shower interrupted hay collection the previous day
cases.situation: At morning he smells warmth from inside a newly built stack meant for winter feed.

cases.knowledge_need: How a late frost settles in low ground and can damage newly uncovered seedlings despite warmer air at head height.
cases.circumstances: a clear calm evening follows a mild spring day
cases.situation: Before sleep she sees the sky clearing and must decide which tender rows need cover.

cases.knowledge_need: How a leaning trunk, lodged branches, and wind direction can make a partly cut tree fall differently from its intended path.
cases.circumstances: a breeze begins after he has started a notch cut
cases.situation: He notices dead limbs above and must not continue as if the tree were clear.

cases.knowledge_need: How sawdust, wet rungs, and poor communication between workers above and below a sawpit create falling and cut hazards.
cases.circumstances: a light rain starts during a long timber cut
cases.situation: The upper worker cannot see the lower worker's footing as the log begins to shift.

cases.knowledge_need: How a slow bilge leak, added cargo weight, and a change from calm water to chop can make bailing urgent.
cases.circumstances: the vessel left shore dry but wind rises halfway across
cases.situation: She sees water collecting below loose sacks and must protect both balance and cargo.

cases.knowledge_need: How an undercut bank concealed by reeds can collapse when a loaded person steps from a boat onto its edge.
cases.circumstances: high water followed several days of rain
cases.situation: At dusk he must bring a bundle ashore where the usual landing looks intact.

cases.knowledge_need: How rising groundwater can float empty wooden tubs and contaminate stored food before visible surface flooding reaches a house.
cases.circumstances: spring river water has risen for two days
cases.situation: She hears containers knocking below the floor and must protect what can still be saved.

cases.knowledge_need: How low winter sun reflected from snow can hide ruts, ice, and changes in slope during a loaded sledge journey.
cases.circumstances: afternoon sun breaks through after a snowfall
cases.situation: He must choose a safe pace while the track ahead appears nearly flat.

cases.knowledge_need: How fog muffles sound and distorts distance near water, making familiar calls and landmarks unreliable for a lone walker.
cases.circumstances: dense dawn fog follows a warm night
cases.situation: She loses sight of the path and hears birds and water from uncertain directions.

cases.knowledge_need: How a tree struck by lightning can retain damaged hanging limbs and a smoldering hollow after the thunder has passed.
cases.circumstances: a violent summer storm has just moved away
cases.situation: He considers sheltering beneath a large oak that now smells of smoke.

cases.knowledge_need: How heavy rain upstream can cloud a normally clear spring and carry surface contamination into a collection point.
cases.circumstances: a thunderstorm ended shortly before dawn
cases.situation: She arrives with clean jars and sees the water running brown around the outlet.

cases.knowledge_need: How covering a hot stew tightly and leaving it in a warm corner delays cooling and can make leftovers less safe by morning.
cases.circumstances: a crowded evening leaves little shelf space away from the hearth
cases.situation: After serving supper he wants to save a pot for workers before dawn.

cases.knowledge_need: How spilled grain, cracks behind storage bins, and a nearby cat's limited access affect signs of rodents in a granary.
cases.circumstances: harvest sacks were moved quickly before a rainstorm
cases.situation: At first inspection she finds fresh droppings and gnawed chaff near the wall.

cases.knowledge_need: How repeated wetting, sun exposure, and alkaline residue can weaken a linen strip even as it becomes paler.
cases.circumstances: several bright days follow a hard wash
cases.situation: He must decide whether a fine headcloth needs another treatment or has had enough.

cases.knowledge_need: How twisting fiber while it is too dry or too wet changes strength and makes a new cord untwist under a load.
cases.circumstances: morning mist gives way to dry wind
cases.situation: She needs a short reliable cord for securing a bundle before travel.

cases.knowledge_need: How heating an empty iron pot too quickly after washing can warp it and burn residue onto its base.
cases.circumstances: rainwater remains in the pot while fuel burns unusually hot
cases.situation: At midday he must prepare food with limited water and one cooking vessel.

cases.knowledge_need: How an uneven pack, a slipping girth, and a narrow side slope can make a donkey stumble toward a ditch.
cases.circumstances: wet leaves cover the sloping track
cases.situation: She notices one pannier sagging while the animal carries fragile jars.

cases.knowledge_need: How a small thorn puncture acquired in manure-rich soil can worsen if dirt remains trapped beneath the skin.
cases.circumstances: he steps on a thorn while clearing wet bedding
cases.situation: Before returning to work he sees only a tiny puncture but feels grit in it.

cases.knowledge_need: How ground moisture, compressed bedding, and a wind gap under a wall can draw heat away through the night.
cases.circumstances: a dry evening follows a day of cold rain
cases.situation: Before sleep she must arrange limited cloaks and straw for a child near the wall.
